# OpsArmor development

OpsArmor is a Go CLI and local web UI that scans explicitly registered Linux hosts: remote hosts over SSH, or the machine it runs on. Commands run on a scanned host are fixed, read-only strings (package inventory reads in `internal/target`, optional checks in `internal/checks`) and go through the `target.Target` interface, implemented over SSH by `internal/remote` and locally by `internal/local`. They may run through `sudo` only when the host allows it. Enforce SSH known-host verification, never persist private key material or credentials, and never report a failed or incomplete scan as clean.

`opsarmor serve` hosts a loopback-only React UI from `web/` (embedded via `web/embed.go`) over the JSON API in `internal/server`; hosts and scans live in SQLite via `internal/store`. Build with `make build` (or `go build ./cmd/opsarmor` without the UI); run `go test ./...` and `go vet ./...`. Only enable a platform when its official advisory source and evaluator are verified. Unsupported advisory rules must be reported, never counted as clean.
